dunmar_fusewick.name: Dunmar Fusewick

dunmar_fusewick.description: Lights the fuse first and decides where to throw it second.

otmar_caskwright.name: Otmar Caskwright

dame_ysolt_kerne.title: Mercy of the Vigil

brother_odrin_wick.name: Brother Odrin Wick

torvald_greyhame.name: Torvald Greyhame
torvald_greyhame.title: Warden-Captain

bertram_hobnail.name: Bertram Hobnail
bertram_hobnail.title: Drill-Serjeant
bertram_hobnail.description: Trained half the watch and has outlived most of it.

emric_dawnhollow.name: Emric Dawnhollow
emric_dawnhollow.title: Watch-Lieutenant
emric_dawnhollow.description: Chooses the target and lets the others take the shot.

kesta_wirewright.description: Builds the watch's snares and tips its bolts with worse.

rask_notchblade.name: Rask Notchblade
rask_notchblade.title: Wall-Clearer

hulbrand_oxbow.name: Hulbrand Oxbow
hulbrand_oxbow.title: Springald Bearer
hulbrand_oxbow.description: Carries on one shoulder a bolt-thrower meant for a cart.

jessa_stillbreath.name: Jessa Stillbreath
jessa_stillbreath.title: Tower Marksman
jessa_stillbreath.description: Has kept one arrow-slit for eleven winters.
jessa_stillbreath.abilityDesc: Held Breath — extreme range, bonus vs elites.

greywatch_arbalester.name: Greywatch Arbalester
greywatch_arbalester.title: Citadel Crossbowman
greywatch_arbalester.description: A rank-and-file crossbowman of the mountain citadel.

hale_brandreth.name: Hale Brandreth
hale_brandreth.title: Company Captain
hale_brandreth.description: Captain of the Sawtooth. Pays late and fights early.
hale_brandreth.abilityDesc: Sawback Glaive — saw-edged finisher on low HP foes.

derrow_fenn.name: Derrow Fenn
derrow_fenn.title: Shield-Mate
derrow_fenn.description: Has stood at the captain's left hand since the first ditch.

pell_rivetson.name: Pell Rivetson
pell_rivetson.title: Company Artificer

jorram_brakeless.name: Jorram Brakeless

tam_nockley.name: Tam Nockley

garrow_twinstring.name: Garrow Twinstring

sawtooth_pavisier.name: Sawtooth Pavisier

dorn_quarrykin.name: Dorn Quarrykin
dorn_quarrykin.title: Quarry Axeman

gerent_gatesby.name: Gerent Gatesby

marta_hobblethorn.name: Marta Hobblethorn
marta_hobblethorn.title: Troll-Hunter

kell_splitlip.name: Kell Splitlip

hesk_hardpalm.name: Hesk Hardpalm

grudd_filetooth.name: Grudd Filetooth
grudd_filetooth.title: The Gnawer

tunn_oxhide.name: Tunn Oxhide

wend_reedhand.name: Wend Reedhand

uggar_no_tongue.name: Uggar No-Tongue

cael_slingsong.name: Cael Slingsong

gaunt_ironrib.name: Gaunt Ironrib

neve_shardglass.name: Neve Shardglass

aubrin_needlepoint.name: Aubrin Needlepoint

hesper_brazier.name: Hesper Brazier

sister_quillane.name: Sister Quillane

brannet_doublet.name: Brannet Doublet

pella_ribbonmane.name: Pella Ribbonmane

gorhame_the_unbowed.name: Gorhame the Unbowed

sorrel_scytheheel.name: Sorrel Scytheheel

lorn_spitgravel.name: Lorn Spitgravel

varrow_cindersight.name: Varrow Cindersight

emmet_kindling.name: Emmet Kindling

isk_farflame.name: Isk Farflame

selka_whiteash.name: Selka Whiteash

gulch_the_glutton.name: Gulch the Glutton

mother_scoria.name: Mother Scoria

ivo_harrowgate.name: Ivo Harrowgate

brother_malloch.name: Brother Malloch
brother_malloch.title: Psalm-Warden
brother_malloch.description: Sings the wrathful psalms and keeps time with a mace.
brother_malloch.abilityDesc: Psalm of Wrath — terrifies nearby foes on strike.

sister_ottoline_reed.name: Sister Ottoline Reed
sister_ottoline_reed.title: Hex-Finder
sister_ottoline_reed.description: Keeps the order's list of witches and crosses the names off herself.

provost_kerrick.name: Provost Kerrick

provost_kerrick.abilityDesc: Deserter's Wage — finishes routed, low-HP enemies.

iron_psalm_levy.name: Iron Psalm Levy

iron_psalm_levy.description: A tithed villager with a crossbow and a psalm book.
iron_psalm_levy.abilityDesc: Levy Volley — steady ranged line-holder with splash volleys.

brother_hulm.name: Brother Hulm
brother_hulm.title: Tower-Shield Brother
brother_hulm.description: Carries a door of oak and iron and stands behind it.
brother_hulm.abilityDesc: Tower Shield — damage reduction pulse when wounded.

tobiah_bronzeback.name: Tobiah Bronzeback

tobiah_bronzeback.description: Carries a recast church bell on his back and fires it.
tobiah_bronzeback.abilityDesc: Bronze Bombard — devastates siege engines and structures.

davin_glasswright.name: Davin Glasswright

davin_glasswright.description: The guild's hired sword, paid in glass and loyal for it.

obsidia_kiln.name: Obsidia Kiln

obsidia_kiln.abilityDesc: Kiln Burst — burst fire when enemies cluster.

elowen_saltmere.name: Elowen Saltmere
elowen_saltmere.title: Guild Physic

corbet_highvault.name: Corbet Highvault

thessaly_prism.name: Thessaly Prism

harl_crackglaze.name: Harl Crackglaze

harl_crackglaze.abilityDesc: Shatter Point — massive spike when wounded.

guild_shardbow.name: Guild Shardbow

guild_shardbow.description: A guild crossbowman shooting glass-headed bolts.
guild_shardbow.abilityDesc: Shard Bolt — reliable budget ranged DPS.

hesker_rawhand.name: Hesker Rawhand

hesker_rawhand.abilityDesc: Red Frenzy — damage surges when wounded.

pox_sister_marrin.name: Pox-Sister Marrin

ezrin_splitveil.name: Ezrin Splitveil

ser_culloch_the_flensed.name: Ser Culloch the Flensed

ser_culloch_the_flensed.abilityDesc: Scabbed Plate — brief damage soak below 40% HP.

nym_bloodcup.name: Nym Bloodcup

nym_bloodcup.description: Carries the cult's cup and fills it where he can.

brannoc_ashquarrel.name: Brannoc Ashquarrel
brannoc_ashquarrel.title: Turncoat Crossbowman
brannoc_ashquarrel.description: Deserted an honest company. His quarrels have burned ever since.
brannoc_ashquarrel.abilityDesc: Wound-Fire Bolts — splash vs elite targets.

hrafna_stormthroat.name: Hrafna Stormthroat

hrafna_stormthroat.abilityDesc: Breaking Howl — force wave devastates clustered foes.

skegga_hoarfrost.name: Skegga Hoarfrost

bodmar_lindenshield.name: Bodmar Lindenshield

yrsel_nightfoot.name: Yrsel Nightfoot

yrsel_nightfoot.abilityDesc: Knife in the Dark — bonus crit damage vs wounded targets.

hervild_hearthmender.name: Hervild Hearthmender
